context_requirements: Functional L-type voltage-dependent calcium channels (CACNA1C/CACNA1S) or calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) expression
Intact calcium-dependent signaling to calcineurin/NFAT and CaMK pathways
Proliferating cells with intact G1/S and G2/M checkpoints for antiproliferative effects
falsifiers: No change in any of the proximal immediate-early genes (FOS, EGR1, JUN) at 6 h in any cell line
No antiproliferative or cell-cycle transcriptional signature at 24 h in any cell line
Predominant upregulation of proliferation genes rather than downregulation

evidence.supports: Maitotoxin, a calcium channel activator, inhibits G1/S and G2/M progression and prevents CDC2 kinase activation
Calcium channel activator inhibits proliferation of ovarian cancer cells
L-type calcium channel activator Bay K8644 induces apoptosis in smooth muscle cells
